      <description><p>No one has claimed responsibility for the strike on the vessel, which had docked on its way back to Russia</p><p>A Russian warship docked in the Libyan port city of Benghazi was struck in the early hours of Sunday in a suspected Ukrainian sea drone attack, causing a dramatic night-time explosion and the sinking of the vessel.</p><p>The strike severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette that had stopped to refuel and take on supplies, according to Libyan officials from the country’s eastern government.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/22/blast-russian-ship-suspected-drone-attack-benghazi-libya">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>California’s coastal communities on alert as biggest waves in years hit state</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/20/california-coastal-communities-alert-big-waves-hit-state</link>
      <description><p>Hazard warnings issued throughout week after powerful swells and waves of more than 9 metres recorded</p><p>Multiple coastal hazard warnings were issued this week across California as successive areas of low pressure generated powerful swells and large breaking waves for coastal communities. Beaches and piers were closed last weekend as large waves crashed into California’s coastline. Offshore National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration buoys recorded wave heights of greater than 30ft (9 metres) last Friday. The Monterey, California, buoy recorded a wave height of 34.1ft, which would make it the highest reading in 30 years.</p><p>Coastal warnings extended from last weekend through this week, with alerts extending until Friday night. Waves of 10-18ft are expected, with local sets of 18-22ft for San Luis Obispo county beaches and Santa Barbara county central coast beaches. These Pacific storm systems are also bringing unsettled conditions across the western US, with heavy rain, mountain snow, and strong winds through the coming days. Already, record-breaking rainfall affected San Fransisco on Wednesday, with heavy rain also causing 32,000 customers to lose power in Sacramento. Into this weekend, a further area of low pressure will bring considerable amounts of moisture for southern Oregon and northern California. By Sunday night, more than 100mm (4in) of rain is expected in places, with further snowfall for areas such as Donner Pass across the northern Sierra Nevada mountains.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/20/california-coastal-communities-alert-big-waves-hit-state">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Almost half of women in west and central Africa cannot withhold consent, with girls worst affected, UNFPA finds</p><p>One in four women around the world have no power of consent if their husband or partner demands sex, according to a UN report.</p><p>In west and central Africa, almost half of women (45%) are not able to say no in their own marriage, while a third of women (33%) in east and southern Africa and in Arab states face the same predicament.       <description><p>European Commission president Ursula von der Leyen sets out 22nd package of sanctions</p><p><strong>Turning to Ukraine, Nato’s Rutte stresses the need to secure the flow of “crucial supplies” or air defence weapons and ammunition to Ukraine.</strong></p><p><em><strong>“</strong>It helps Ukraine to defend itself today, but it also strengthens Ukraine’s hands in any future negotiations with Russia. … But support needs to be concrete. <strong>We have to show Putin that his attempts to weaken our support will fail.”</strong></em></p><p><em>“Our citizens need to know that the lights will stay on, that their homes will stay warm, that hospitals, transport and communications will keep working.”</em></p><p><em>“One day it can be in the form of an arson attack against a factory or drones disrupt disrupting an airport.       <title>Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO after Trump intervenes</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/23/jensen-huang-reinstated-as-nvidia-chief-executive</link>
      <description><p>Share price surges as chipmaker reverses decision to remove chief executive after US president ‘convinced’ its board</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/nils-pratley-on-finance/2026/nov/23/nvidia-board-jensen-huang-return">Comment: Nvidia’s humiliated board should resign out of embarrassment</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2026/nov/23/donald-trump-democrats-republicans-presidential-primary-midterms-house-latest-news-updates">US politics – live updates</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/12/jensen-huang-affair-timeline">Timeline: fall and comeback of Jensen Huang</a></p></li></ul><p>Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive after Donald Trump directly intervened with the US AI chipmaker’s board of directors, in a stunning reversal of <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/12/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns">the tech billionaire’s downfall</a>.</p><p>Speaking on Monday shortly after Nvidia’s surprise announcement that Huang had been restored to the top job – less than two weeks after he resigned – Trump said that he had “convinced” the board to do it. “I made the deal,” he told CNBC. Huang had resigned after reports of extramarital affairs, including with an alleged Chinese spy and two Nvidia employees.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/23/jensen-huang-reinstated-as-nvidia-chief-executive">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Environmentalists sued last week to stop detonation of 68 barrels of lead azide over health and pollution concerns </p><p>Donald Trump on Monday halted the planned detonation of several tons of degraded bomb-making material at an Iowa ammunition plant, urging a federal appeals court to first sign off on what he called the safest way to resolve the situation.</p><p>“I feel the proper course is to get rid of this longterm problem but, at the same time, have ordered the Military not to do so until such time as the Eighth Circuit agrees that we can go forward, and am further making this decision fully subject to the incoming Governor-Elect, Rob Sand, agreeing to the operation,” Trump said <a href="https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/117667060434959655">in a Truth Social post</a>.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/23/iowa-lead-bomb-appeals-court">Continue reading...</a></description>
